name: Mechanism pump-start control
summary: Requests operation of the mechanism's pressure-maintaining pump according to its defined demand contact.
description: Requests operation of the mechanism's pressure-maintaining pump according to its defined demand contact. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Pressure-maintenance demand” at the input and “Pump start request” at the output. The hydraulic circuit is documented separately.
